from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model, login
from authlib.integrations.django_client import OAuth

oauth = OAuth()
User = get_user_model()

def callback(request):
    token = oauth.sso.authorize_access_token(request)
    userinfo = token["userinfo"]
    user, _ = User.objects.get_or_create(username=userinfo["preferred_username"])
    login(request, user)
    return redirect("/")

from django.core.mail import send_mail
from django.http import JsonResponse
from .tokens import make_token


def forgot_password(request):
    email = request.POST['email']
    token = make_token(email)
    link = 'https://' + request.get_host() + '/reset/' + token
    send_mail('Reset your password', link, None, [email])
    return JsonResponse({})
